files.record_ports.fsm:
(?fsm:record_ports

  (+types
    (type frame (record (flag bit) (data (signed (four_state (bits 5))))))
  )

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input start)
    (input packet)
    (output result)
    (output seen)
    (output done)
    (internal held)
  )

  (+size
    (start 1)
    (packet frame)
    (result frame)
    (seen 5)
    (done 1)
    (held frame)
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<start
      (-> main_set_1)
    )
  )

  (main_set_1
    (<- (held packet))
    (-> main_set_2)
  )

  (main_set_2
    (<- (result> held))
    (-> main_set_3)
  )

  (main_set_3
    (<- (seen> result.data))
    (-> main_done_4)
  )

  (main_done_4
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

)

source:
(actor record_ports
  (clock clk)
  (reset (rst_n sync active_low))
  (types
    (type frame
      (record (flag bit) (data (signed (four_state (bits 5)))))))
  (interface
    (input start)
    (input packet (type frame))
    (output result (type frame))
    (output seen (width 5))
    (output done))
  (storage (var held (type frame)))
  (transaction main
    (on start)
    (set held packet)
    (set result held)
    (set seen result.data)
    (complete done)))
